feeds.title: Puratattva
feeds.description: Navigating Indian History through its Architecture. Puratattva is a Sanskrit word that translates to Truth of the Old. Back in 2006, while visiting different heritage sites across India, they realized that it was not easy to obtain relevant information about these sites, over the web. Most of the relevant and authentic information was confined to various reference books and journals, far from the reach of a common person. With more and more people visiting these sites every year, these lacunae of missing information require to be filled. And, thus was born Puratattva.
